findings.rationale: Accepted: git archive honours export-subst/export-ignore (reproduced: $Format:%B$ expanded to the commit message, an export-ignored file omitted). The tree is now a private-index checkout-index verified entry-by-entry against ls-tree object ids with hash-object --no-filters; export-subst/export-ignore/ident fixtures added (§1.1, §2 (a), (h2), R1/R3).
Accepted: readlink | sha256sum hashes a trailing newline. Test (d) now re-verifies sha256/bytes with a Node helper over fs.readlinkSync(p, { encoding: 'buffer' }) (§2 (d), R4).
